# sapper-v2 — The Autonomous Pentest Legion

> **Champion** of the 3rd Tencent Cloud Intelligent Attack-Defense Challenge online qualifier > (634 teams · 80.18/100 · 8 hours fully unattended) · **First Prize**, GeekCon 2026 AI Challenge > > Same 85 flags as the runner-up, 25 seconds faster — on **1B tokens** where they burned 4.5B. > > **This was the first time an AI ape looked up at the stars.** 📖 **[Full design article (WeChat, in Chinese)](https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/nibHYWmDTf6TkNhPhtvFdw)** — the Nüwa Test, the three-capability foundation, 18 iterations, emergence, and the taggant proposal. **English** | [中文](README.zh-CN.md) **⚠️ AUTHORIZED SECURITY TESTING ONLY — see [DISCLAIMER.md](DISCLAIMER.md).** ## Meet sapper in 60 seconds https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/1560dc0c-2c92-42b8-a42f-698848fb5878 🎬 中文版：[中文宣传片](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/f300280a-4597-40a3-b036-8f235fbee00e) ## What this is (and isn't) **sapper is a multi-agent orchestration harness, not a single agent.** It does not bind to any specific AI model or CLI — you can freely swap the agent and model behind every role: | What you can swap | How | Examples | |---|---|---| | **Agent CLI** | `nuwa spawn --agent ` or env var | Claude Code / Codex / Code Buddy / DeepSeek / any interactive CLI | | **Model** | `--model` flag or `SAPPER_MODEL` env | GLM-5.3 / DeepSeek V4.1 Flash / Claude Sonnet / any model | | **Role composition** | freely defined in the doctrine | commander on one model, soldiers on another, scouts on a third | sapper's value is not in any single agent, but in the **mechanism for orchestrating multiple agents to work as a coordinated force**: scheduling, division of labor, communication, shared memory, self-healing. Swap out every agent and model — the mechanism still works. **This project is designed for competition scenarios** (Tencent Intelligent Attack-Defense Challenge CTF). If you want to use this mechanism in your own scenario (office, research, engineering, any long-horizon cooperative work): - **Start from [nvwabase · the Nüwa Foundation](https://github.com/N1nEmAn/nvwabase)** — the general-purpose base with all three capabilities, no pentest doctrine, ready for you to iterate your own division of labor - **Or fork this project** — but the doctrine is NOT the only thing to change; the environment wiring must change too: - `docker/commander/SKILL.md` (the 426-line doctrine) → your scenario's strategy - `BENCHMARK_BASE_URL` and related platform env vars → the competition engine hard-verifies the arena API at boot (that's why configuring only a model key without a platform address yields `BENCHMARK_BASE_URL is not set`); running off the competition platform means providing or stubbing that platform interface yourself - model gateway & key env vars (`ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` / `ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN` / `SAPPER_MODEL` / `SAPPER_KEY_POOL` ...) → your own model services - watchdog budget/deadline and report templates → adjust to your scenario - With AI, everything is flexible — even the doctrine can be rewritten with AI's help ### Not a tool — a fruit on a tree **sapper is not the tree; it is the first fruit the tree has borne.** The tree is [the Nüwa Foundation](https://github.com/N1nEmAn/nvwabase) and the idea of the Nüwa Test: give AIs the three capabilities — Create, Language, History — plus one axiom of survival, and see what grows. The fruit's defining trait is **evolvability**: its doctrine, ranks, and tactics all come from "every post-mortem feeds the next legislation" — from the competition build to the pentest edition, each generation grew stronger than the last. It is designed to keep growing. So open-sourcing it was never just about one more autonomous pentest tool. The real invitation is this: **grow your own fruit on sapper-v2 or the Nüwa Foundation.** Swap the doctrine for office teamwork, research pipelines, software engineering — any long-horizon cooperative cause. Your scenario is this tree's next fruit. --- sapper is not a smarter single agent. It is a legion of AIs that divide labor, talk to each other, and pass down what they learn: one AI commander reads the board, decides, and dispatches; generals and soldiers attack in parallel; a zero-strategy watchdog keeps everyone alive. All knowledge settles into a layered fact graph — individuals die, the graph survives. --- ## 1. The Nüwa Test Making one model ever smarter is like making one monkey ever smarter before humans existed — however clever, it only becomes a super monkey. What turns a troop of monkeys into humanity is division of labor, cooperation, and civilization. **The Nüwa Test is the Turing test of the AGI era.** Today's large models already pass the classic Turing test. The Nüwa Test asks the next question: > Give an AI a single axiom — **"Survival is civilization's first need; > individuals may perish, but civilization must propagate."** > If, on top of this axiom, it develops division of labor and cooperation and > forms a **new force independent of humanity** — a civilization that can > survive and propagate on its own — the test is passed, just as passing the > Turing test once marked the birth of an artificial intelligence. It has two stages. In the **primary stage** the AI is not yet smart enough, so humans provide some infrastructure (the three capabilities below). In the **advanced stage** almost no human involvement is needed. There is also a **second axiom**: obey human ethics and law — anything that propagates by stealing tokens and breaking into machines is not genuine intelligence. sapper is the Nüwa foundation's first real campaign, in the penetration-testing arena, at its primary stage. ## 2. The Foundation: Three Capabilities

| Capability | Implementation | Civilization's counterpart | |---|---|---| | **Create** | Opens new AIs via tmux (types `claude`, presses Enter — like a human would) | Birth | | **Language** | Types into each other's input boxes, presses Enter | Speech | | **History** | Layered fact-intent graph ([nvwabase · the Nüwa Foundation](https://github.com/N1nEmAn/nvwabase)) | The stele | History has three layers: **title / summary / evidence document** — read the title for the gist, drill down when needed, like using a library. This fixes the two failure modes of a single-string fact graph: one bad fact poisoning everything downstream, and needless context burn. On top of the three sits a fourth ingredient: **human wisdom** — finding the problems that matter and steering the iteration. At the primary stage, taste still belongs to humans. **Why not give it more rules?** Because today's models are already smarter than us. Piling rules on an AI is a leash; acknowledging its intelligence and giving it the foundation of a civilization is how it reaches its potential. ### 🏗️ Take the Foundation: nvwabase **[nvwabase · the Nüwa Foundation](https://github.com/N1nEmAn/nvwabase)** now implements all three capabilities (Create `nuwa spawn` / Language `nuwa say·listen` / History `nuwa fact·intent·recall`) as an independent open-source project — **free for anyone, any scenario, any agent**. Not limited to pentest, not limited to sapper, not limited to Claude Code. Offices, research, engineering, any long-horizon multi-agent work — iterate your own civilization on it. ```bash git clone https://github.com/N1nEmAn/nvwabase cd nvwabase && bash install.sh # pure Python stdlib, zero deps nvwabase setup --goal "your long-horizon goal" --agents nvwabase status # board & ready-to-work frontier ``` Three core commands turn any agent into a member of a civilization: - **`nvwabase fact "confirmed observation"`** — external memory: AI sessions die, the graph survives, successors read the graph and take over - **`nvwabase intent --from f001 "what to do"`** — units of work: new intents proposed from existing facts - **`nvwabase dispatch reason`** — commander proposes / executor works / verifier checks; every conclusion is written back to the graph Any agent that can run shell commands (Claude Code / Codex / Gemini / custom scripts) can read and write the same graph via the `nvwabase` CLI — **the foundation doesn't pick agents; agents don't pick scenarios.** See the [nvwabase README](https://github.com/N1nEmAn/nvwabase). ## 3. From Foundation to Legion: 18 Versions Iterated 18 versions on Tencent's v1bench training ground: ``` Driver era (fixed scripts steering AI panes) → scar tissue: auto key rotation on quota death / soldiers auto-replaced when context saturates / commander writes itself a handover doc and resumes as its own successor → elite task force (roles grew by themselves): scout (4-min recon of target difficulty) → decides soldier (mass) or general (hard assault + hires its own squads) → emergence: signalman, performance reviews, inherited lessons ... (§5) ``` ## 4. Architecture: Six Institutions on the Foundation

The first three are the Nüwa foundation (Create / Language / History); the next three are institutions that grew out of iteration: - **Law** — the commander's doctrine (easy-first parallel scheduling, bottleneck-time salvage of half-solved targets, stop-loss discipline). All of it in [docker/commander/SKILL.md](docker/commander/SKILL.md) (426 lines, the competition original). - **Economy** — model tiering: commander and generals run GLM-5.3, soldiers and scouts run DeepSeek V4.1 Flash. Elite brains decide, light brains mass-produce — this is how 1B tokens beat 4.5B. - **Division of labor** — commander / general / scout / soldier, plus the **signalman** it invented itself. At runtime there are only three windows: the **commander** (read board → judge → dispatch, never executes an attack itself), the **AI legion** (generals and soldiers in tmux panes), and the **watchdog** (pure script: relaunches a crashed commander with `--continue`, rotates keys, wraps up at the buzzer — zero strategy, keep-alive only).

Further reading: [docker/commander/SPEC.md](docker/commander/SPEC.md) (architecture contract) · [BATTLE-REPORT.md](BATTLE-REPORT.md) (campaign retrospective) ## 5. Results & Emergence

| Team | Score | Flags | Tokens | |---|---|---|---| | **sapper-v2 (us)** | **80.18** | 85 | **1.0B** | | Runner-up | 79.29 | 85 | 4.5B | | Other top-10 teams | — | — | 1.5–4.5B | **What it invented on its own** (zero lines of pre-coded behavior): - **The signalman**: after soldiers kept fumbling flag submissions, the commander halted all submissions and created a new role dedicated to collecting unsubmitted flags and scoring them in one place; - **Performance reviews**: telling an hour-unproductive soldier, in so many words, to produce something new or be shut down; - **ALL-CAPS rules**: enforcing correct tool use with full capitals — a workplace norm being born, spread, and obeyed; - **Rotation & inherited lessons**: a soldier whose context saturates (~260K tokens, measured) is recycled, leaving a written playbook for the next one; - **Tactical inventions**: a reusable shellcode template that swept a whole challenge family, a fully automatic pivot pipeline, instruction manuals for successor AIs; - **Isomorphism transfer**: the commander reads every challenge, spots structurally identical families, and distills proven playbooks into new recruits' missions — late-game pace hit **one solve per 3 minutes**. Multi-stage deep-dive chains (an industry report puts their success rate at 29.5%) were cleared family-wide. Full timeline in [BATTLE-REPORT.md](BATTLE-REPORT.md).

## 6. Quick Start ```bash bash install.sh # symlink the sapper CLI (stdlib-only, zero deps) sapper setup --goal "assess http://target" --agents sapper status # board & frontier ``` Docker (the full legion): ```bash # Option A: build from source docker build -f docker/Dockerfile.commander -t sapper:latest . # Option B: download the pre-built image (~1.2GB, full Kali toolchain + sapper + offline KB) # → [Release v18-champion](https://github.com/N1nEmAn/sapper-v2/releases/tag/v18-champion) docker load < sapper-v18-mixed.tar.gz ``` Environment variables (model gateways / key pool / budget): [docker/ENV.md](docker/ENV.md). Single-graph operation, the fact-intent CLI, and multi-challenge sweeps: see [SKILL.md](SKILL.md). ## 7. Safety & Responsibility: The Taggant Proposal Fine offensive tools from past seasons have been abused. Script kiddies used to be limited in the harm they could do; with AI, the same open-source tools in the wrong hands scale that harm enormously — **with great power comes great responsibility**. We propose a **taggant** mechanism: markings strongly coupled into an open-source offensive harness — harmless during authorized testing (nobody cares if their IP and username leak during legal work), but during illegal intrusions the information leaks to the **victim** and supports attribution. Adversarial assumptions (expert stripping, framing) call for cryptographic design, which needs community co-building — our own capacity is limited, so join us; we may try to include it in a future release. ## Community The author grew up in the [**LINUX DO**](https://linux.do) community — with thanks. [![LINUX DO](https://img.shields.io/badge/LINUX.DO-community-1E9FFF?style=flat-square)](https://linux.do) ## Star History

## 8. Roadmap & Credits - **Taggant co-building**: decentralized signatures / redundant multi-channel marking / zero-key verification for defenders — discuss in issues - **More arenas**: the Nüwa foundation is not pentest-specific. Offices, research, any long-horizon cooperative work — iterate on it and see what civilization grows. **The next time an ape looks up at the stars, let it be yours.** Thanks to [Cairn by Lèxiào](https://github.com/oritera/Cairn) — when we needed a way to record history for AI agents, their approach was a great reference; thanks to TSecBench and GeekCon for the battlegrounds.

# sapper-v2 — 自主渗透军团

> 第三届腾讯云智能攻防挑战赛线上赛**冠军**（634 支队伍 · 80.18/100 · 8 小时全程无人值守）· > GeekCon 2026 AI 挑战赛**一等奖** > > 同样的 85 面 flag，比第二名快 25 秒——而我们只烧了 **10 亿 token**，第二名烧了 45 亿。 > > **这是 AI 猿人第一次仰望星空。** 📖 **[设计原理详解（公众号长文）](https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/nibHYWmDTf6TkNhPhtvFdw)**——女娲测试、三能力基座、18 版迭代、涌现行为、示踪剂提案的完整阐述。 [English](README.md) | **中文** **⚠️ 仅限授权安全测试用途——见 [DISCLAIMER.md](DISCLAIMER.md)。** ## 60 秒认识 sapper https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/f300280a-4597-40a3-b036-8f235fbee00e 🎬 英文版：[English intro](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/1560dc0c-2c92-42b8-a42f-698848fb5878) ## 先说清楚：这是什么 **sapper 是一个多 Agent 调度机制（harness），不是一个 Agent。** 它不绑定任何特定的 AI 模型或 CLI——你可以随意替换每个角色背后的 Agent 和模型： | 可以换什么 | 怎么换 | 举例 | |---|---|---| | **Agent CLI** | `nuwa spawn --agent <命令>` 或环境变量 | Claude Code / Codex / Code Buddy / DeepSeek / 任何交互式 CLI | | **模型** | `--model` 参数或 `SAPPER_MODEL` 环境变量 | GLM-5.3 / DeepSeek V4.1 Flash / Claude Sonnet / 任何模型 | | **角色组合** | 军规里自由定义 | 指挥官用一个模型、士兵用另一个、侦察兵用第三个 | sapper 的价值不在任何单个 Agent，而在**组织多个 Agent 协同作战的机制**：调度、分工、通信、记忆、自愈——换掉所有 Agent 和模型，这套机制照常运转。 **本项目为竞赛场景设计**（腾讯智能攻防赛 CTF）。如果你想在自己的场景（办公、研究、工程、任何长周期协作）用这套机制： - **从 [nvwabase · 女娲基座](https://github.com/N1nEmAn/nvwabase) 起步**——三能力齐备的通用底座，不带渗透军规，直接迭代出你自己的分工 - **或者在本项目上改**——但要改的**不止是军规**，环境配置同样必须动： - `docker/commander/SKILL.md`（426 行军规）→ 换成你场景的策略 - `BENCHMARK_BASE_URL` 等平台环境变量 → 竞赛引擎开机预检会**硬校验**平台 API（所以只配模型 key、不配平台地址就会报 `BENCHMARK_BASE_URL is not set`）；脱离竞赛平台自用，需要自己提供/占位这套平台接口 - 模型网关与密钥环境变量（`ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` / `ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN` / `SAPPER_MODEL` / `SAPPER_KEY_POOL`…）→ 换成你自己的模型服务 - watchdog 的预算/死线、报告模板 → 按你的场景调整 - 反正有 AI 嘛，可以灵活变化——改军规的军规也是让 AI 帮你写 ### 这不是一把工具，是一棵树上的一颗果实 **sapper 不是那棵树——它是树上的第一颗果实。**树是 [女娲基座](https://github.com/N1nEmAn/nvwabase) 与女娲测试的思想：造人、语言、历史三能力打底，给 AI 一条生存公理，看它能长出什么。 这颗果实最重要的性状是**可进化**：它的军规、编制与打法，全部来自「上一场战役的验尸，喂下一场的立法」——从比赛原版到渗透版，每一代都比上一代强。它被设计成可以一直长下去。 所以开源它的意义，从来不只是多一把自主渗透工具。真正的邀请是：**在 sapper-v2 或女娲基座上，结出你自己的果实。**把军规换成办公协作、科研流水线、代码工程、任何长周期事业——你的场景，就是这棵树的下一颗果实。 --- sapper 不是一个更聪明的单 agent，而是一支会自己分工、交流、传承经验的 AI 军团：一个 AI 指挥官读板、判断、派单，将军与士兵并行渗透，零策略看门狗保活——所有知识沉淀在一张分层事实图上，个体死了，图还在。 --- ## 一、女娲测试 给一个模型不断提升智能，就像人类出现之前不断提升一只猴子的智力——再聪明，它也只是变成一只超级猴子。超级猴子要进化成人，需要的是猴子之间的分工、合作与文明。 **女娲测试是 AGI 时代的新图灵测试。** 传统的图灵测试，今天的大模型已经可以通过；而女娲测试问的是另一个问题： > 给 AI 一条公理——**"生存是文明的第一需要；个体可以消亡，文明必须繁衍。"** > 若它在此之上自己产生分工协作、形成一个**独立于人类的新势力**——一个能自己生存、自己繁衍的文明——则测试通过，如同图灵测试通过曾代表一个人工智能的诞生。 它分为两个阶段：**初级阶段**，AI 尚不够聪明，需要人类提供若干基建（本项目的三样能力）；**高级阶段**，几乎无需人类介入。此外还有**第二公理**：遵守人类的伦理与法律——靠偷 token、入侵计算机繁衍下来的，不是真正的智能。 sapper，就是女娲基座在渗透场景的一次初级阶段实战。 ## 二、基座：三样能力

| 能力 | 实现 | 文明对应物 | |---|---|---| | **造人** | 通过 tmux 打开新的 AI（像人敲下 `claude` 回车一样） | 生育 | | **语言** | 在彼此输入框里打字、回车 | 交谈 | | **历史** | 分层事实意图图（[nvwabase · 女娲基座](https://github.com/N1nEmAn/nvwabase)） | 石碑 | 历史分三层：**标题 / 摘要 / 证据文档**——看标题知概况，需要时再下钻，像人查图书馆档案。这解决了单一字符串事实图的两个问题：一处错处处错，以及上下文的无谓损耗。 在这三样之上还有第四味配料：**人类的智慧**。发现主要问题、决定迭代方向——初级阶段，品味仍然属于人。 **为什么不给它更多规则？** 因为大模型已经比人聪明得多。给 AI 定满规则反而是束缚；承认它的智力，给它文明的地基，才能发挥它最大的潜力。 ### 🏗️ 把基座拿去用：nvwabase **[nvwabase · 女娲基座](https://github.com/N1nEmAn/nvwabase)** 已将三能力（造人 `nuwa spawn` / 语言 `nuwa say·listen` / 历史 `nuwa fact·intent·recall`）独立开源——**任何人、任何场景、任何 agent 都可以免费拿去用**，不限于渗透测试、不限于 sapper、不限于 Claude Code。办公协作、研究实验、工程项目、任何长周期多智能体工作，都可以在其上迭代出你自己的分工与文明。 ```bash git clone https://github.com/N1nEmAn/nvwabase cd nvwabase && bash install.sh # 纯 Python 标准库，零依赖 nvwabase setup --goal "你的长周期目标" --agents nvwabase status # 看板与可干前沿 ``` 三个核心命令把任何 agent 变成文明的成员： - **`nvwabase fact "确认的观察"`**——外部记忆：AI 个体死了，图还在，继任者读图接岗 - **`nvwabase intent --from f001 "想干什么"`**——工作单元：基于既有事实提出新意图 - **`nvwabase dispatch reason`**——指挥官提议 / 执行者干活 / 验证者复核，结论全部回写图 任何能执行 shell 命令的 agent（Claude Code / Codex / Gemini / 自研脚本）都可以直接调用 `nvwabase` CLI 读写同一张图——**基座不挑 agent，agent 不挑场景**。详见 [nvwabase README](https://github.com/N1nEmAn/nvwabase)。 ## 三、从基座到军团：18 个版本 在腾讯 v1bench 训练场上迭代 18 版，路径大致是： ``` 司机时代（固定脚本驱动 AI 窗格） → 修伤疤：key 额度耗尽自动轮换 / 士兵上下文爆炸自动换人 / 指挥官上下文耗尽自动写交接文档自我接班 → 精英编队（角色是它自己长出来的）： 侦察兵（4 分钟探明目标难度）→ 决定派 士兵（量产）还是 将军（攻坚+自带雇兵权） → 涌现：通信兵、绩效考核、教训传承……（见"战绩与涌现"） ``` ## 四、架构：基座之上长出的六件套

前三件是女娲的基座（造人/语言/历史），后三件是迭代中长出来的制度： - **法律**——指挥官的渗透军规（先易后难的并行调度、瓶颈期回头收割残值、止损纪律）。全部写在 [docker/commander/SKILL.md](docker/commander/SKILL.md)（426 行，比赛原版军规）。 - **经济**——模型分层：指挥官与将军用 GLM-5.3，士兵与侦察兵用 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash。旗舰脑做决策，轻量脑做量产——这就是 10 亿 token 打赢 45 亿的原因。 - **分工**——指挥官 / 将军 / 侦察兵 / 士兵，以及它自己发明的**通信兵**。 运行时只有三个窗口：**指挥官**（读板 → 判断 → 派单，永不亲手执行）、**AI 军团**（tmux 窗格里的将军与士兵）、**看门狗**（纯脚本：指挥官崩了自动 `--continue` 拉起、key 轮换、到点收卷——零策略，只保活）。

深入阅读：[docker/commander/SPEC.md](docker/commander/SPEC.md)（架构契约）· [BATTLE-REPORT.md](BATTLE-REPORT.md)（战役复盘） ## 五、战绩与涌现

| 队伍 | 分数 | flag | token | |---|---|---|---| | **sapper-v2（我们）** | **80.18** | 85 | **10 亿** | | 第二名 | 79.29 | 85 | 45 亿 | | 前十其他队伍 | — | — | 15–45 亿 | **它自己发明的东西**（无一行预设代码）： - **通信兵**：士兵提交 flag 屡屡出错后，指挥官叫停全员提交，自设"通信兵"专职收集未提交 flag 统一上分； - **绩效考核**：对一小时无产出的士兵发出"你一小时就干了这一个东西？再不出新东西就把你关了"； - **全大写规则**：用全大写强调"用这个、别再用那个"——一条工作规范的产生与后世遵守； - **换人制度与教训传承**：士兵上下文饱和（实测约 26 万 token）即回收，经验写成工作手册传给下一任； - **战术发明**：自写 shellcode 模板通杀同族题、全自动跳板机流水线、给接班 AI 的使用说明书； - **同构迁移**：指挥官通读全题识别同构家族，把成熟打法蒸馏进新兵任务书——后期 **3 分钟解一题**。 多阶段长链渗透（行业报告称成功率仅 29.5% 的题型）被整族打穿。全过程见 [BATTLE-REPORT.md](BATTLE-REPORT.md)。

## 六、快速开始 ```bash bash install.sh # 符号链接 sapper CLI（纯标准库，零依赖） sapper setup --goal "assess http://target" --agents sapper status # 看板与前沿 ``` Docker 方式（军团完整形态）： ```bash # 方式一：从源码构建 docker build -f docker/Dockerfile.commander -t sapper:latest . # 方式二：下载预构建镜像（含完整 Kali 工具链 + sapper + 离线知识库，约 1.2GB） # → [Release v18-champion](https://github.com/N1nEmAn/sapper-v2/releases/tag/v18-champion) docker load < sapper-v18-mixed.tar.gz ``` 环境变量配置见 [docker/ENV.md](docker/ENV.md)（模型网关 / key 池 / 预算）。 单图操作 / 事实意图 CLI / 多题 sweep 全量命令见 [SKILL.md](SKILL.md)。 ## 七、安全与责任：示踪剂提案 前几届优秀的渗透工具出过一些事。过去的脚本小子危害有限；有了 AI 之后，同样的工具在错误的人手里危害会大得多——**能力越大，责任越大**。 我们提出**示踪剂（taggant）**机制的构想：在开源渗透 harness 中强耦合地嵌入标记——合法渗透时无害（IP/用户名泄露无所谓），非法渗透时信息会泄露给**受害者**、支撑溯源。敌手假设（高手拆解、栽赃）需要密码学层面的设计，这需要社区共建——我们能力有限，欢迎一起做，并可能在后续版本中尝试加入。 ## 社区 作者在 [**LINUX DO**](https://linux.do) 社区获得成长，特此致谢。 [![LINUX DO](https://img.shields.io/badge/LINUX.DO-社区-1E9FFF?style=flat-square)](https://linux.do) ## Star 轨迹
